cautions: Winter here means 28 September to 31 March.
The list shows only areas with at least 1 square km of bare ground.
We do not count cloud. These are hours of low Sun on ground that is probably free of snow. They are not hours of visible Sun.
Near a coast, the snow odds come from few land pixels of the snow maps. Each patch in the list gives the number of pixels.
Bare ground at a coast can be beach, tidal flat, rock or a quarry. We did not find out which.
If a patch has few land-cover samples, the error in its bare area can be approximately as large as the bare area itself.
The list does not include areas with less than 20 percent land. Thus, small islands and skerries are not in the list.
Hours after terrain are available only for the 303 areas that have a terrain horizon.
Hours after terrain are a mean over all the land of an area, not over its bare ground.
North of approximately 67 N, the winter hours are in October and March, not in midwinter.
Region names come from approximate boxes of latitude and longitude. An area near a border can have the name of the region next to it.
